FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Our library and museum operates as a cultural hub that provides access to a vast collection of books, documents, and artifacts. We engage with our community through educational programs, workshops, and exhibitions aimed at promoting literacy and appreciation of cultural heritage. Our facilities are equipped with basic security measures, which include locked display cases and alarm systems, although we currently do not have comprehensive surveillance measures in place. As part of our commitment to preservation, we maintain climate control measures to protect sensitive materials, ensuring optimal conditions for our collections. Our staff are trained in collection handling and safety protocols, and we conduct maintenance as needed to uphold a welcoming and functional environment for our visitors.

Our libraries and museums provide open access to the public, allowing visitors to freely explore the exhibits and resources without implementing controlled access or surveillance camera systems.
